cases.command: mkdir -p /data/tartime/p && printf x > /data/tartime/p/a && chmod 640 /data/tartime/p/a && touch -d '2025-08-13 10:00:00' /data/tartime/p/a /data/tartime/p && tar -cf /data/tartime.tar -C /data/tartime p && mkdir /data/tartime/x && tar -xf /data/tartime.tar -C /data/tartime/x && stat -c '%a %y %n' /data/tartime/x/p /data/tartime/x/p/a; mkdir /data/tartime/m && tar -xmf /data/tartime.tar -C /data/tartime/m && find /data/tartime/m -newermt 2025-08-14 | sort
cases.note: tar -x restores each member's mtime, a directory's included, and -m leaves the extraction time.
